name: io.github.desastreger/open-data-mcp-servers
title: Open Data B2B & Compliance MCP Servers
description: 20 production-ready, zero-key remote Streamable HTTP MCP servers & Apify Actors backed by official US/EU government registries and RFC protocols.

servers.name: SEC Form D Scraper — Startup Funding & EIN ($1/1k)
servers.description: Real-time US startup venture & Reg D private placement rounds directly from SEC EDGAR Form D XML filings. Filters out pooled hedge/PE funds automatically and extracts CEO/founder names, phones, HQ addresses, EINs, and federal grant history.
servers.dataSources: SEC EDGAR Form D XML, SEC Submissions API, USASpending.gov

tools.name: search_startup_funding_leads
tools.description: Search real-time US startup venture & private placement funding rounds from official SEC EDGAR Form D filings. Returns decision-maker names/titles, phone, HQ address, exact amount raised, EIN, and optional federal grant history.

tools.name: get_company_funding_dossier
tools.description: Look up a specific US private company by name or CIK across SEC EDGAR Form D filings, SEC entity metadata (EIN, SIC, prior rounds), and USASpending.gov federal contracts/grants.

tools.name: summarize_funding_market
tools.description: Aggregate recent US private placement volume, median/total capital raised, top states, and top industries from recent SEC Form D operating startup filings.

servers.name: US KYB & Compliance Scraper — SEC, LEI, FDA ($1/1k)
servers.description: One-call US Know-Your-Business (KYB) and vendor risk due-diligence dossier aggregating GLEIF Global LEI corporate hierarchy, SEC EDGAR filings, FDA Drug & Device recalls, CFPB consumer complaints, and USASpending federal contracts.
servers.dataSources: GLEIF LEI, SEC EDGAR, FDA openFDA, CFPB, USASpending.gov

tools.name: screen_company_kyb
tools.description: Generate a deterministic Know-Your-Business (KYB) & vendor compliance dossier for a single company across 5 official public registries: GLEIF Global LEI, SEC EDGAR, FDA openFDA Recalls, CFPB Consumer Complaints, and USASpending Federal Contracts.

tools.name: batch_screen_companies
tools.description: Batch-screen up to 20 companies across GLEIF LEI, SEC EDGAR, FDA openFDA Recalls, CFPB Consumer Complaints, and USASpending Federal Contracts, returning deterministic 0-100 KYB verification scores, verification statuses, and risk flags.

servers.name: GovCon Recompete Contracts & Grants Scraper ($0.80/1k)
servers.description: Track expiring US federal contracts entering recompete windows (USASpending.gov) and live open/forecasted federal grants (Grants.gov) with incumbent vendor names, UEIs, obligated ceiling values, NAICS/PSC codes, and expiration countdowns.
servers.dataSources: USASpending.gov, Grants.gov

tools.name: search_expiring_recompete_contracts
tools.description: Search active US federal contracts (USASpending.gov) expiring within the next N days to identify incumbent recompete capture opportunities, incumbent vendor names, obligated contract values, NAICS codes, and awarding agencies.

tools.name: search_open_federal_grants
tools.description: Search live open ("posted") and upcoming ("forecasted") US federal grant & R&D funding opportunities directly from official Grants.gov APIs.

servers.name: Building Permits Scraper — Solar & Roofing ($0.50/1k)
servers.description: Harmonized US municipal building, solar PV, roofing, electrical, HVAC/mechanical, plumbing, and commercial remodel permits across 5 major metros (Los Angeles, Chicago, Austin, San Francisco, Seattle) with contractor names, valuations, and lead scores.
servers.dataSources: LA, Chicago, Austin, SF & Seattle Socrata Open Data APIs

tools.name: search_metro_building_permits
tools.description: Search live municipal building, solar PV, roofing, electrical, HVAC/mechanical, plumbing, new construction, and commercial remodel permits across major US metros (Chicago, Austin, Seattle, Los Angeles, San Francisco) with contractor names, valuations, and B2B lead scores.

tools.name: list_supported_permit_metros
tools.description: List all supported US municipal building permit Socrata portals (Chicago, Austin, Seattle, Los Angeles, San Francisco), their live dataset URLs, ordering fields, and supported trade filters.

servers.name: US Tariff (HTS), EU VAT & TED Tenders Scraper ($0.80/1k)
servers.description: Cross-border customs & European procurement intelligence: calculate official USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) duty rates + Chapter 99 footnotes, verify EU corporate VAT numbers via EC VIES, and search EU TED public tenders.
servers.dataSources: USITC HTS API, European Commission VIES, EU TED API v3

tools.name: lookup_us_hts_tariff
tools.description: Look up official US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) duty rates from USITC, deterministically compute base ad-valorem USD duty estimates for a shipment value, inherit 8-digit parent rates on statistical subheadings, and flag Chapter 99 / Section 301 trade-remedy footnotes.

tools.name: verify_eu_vat_numbers
tools.description: Verify European Union corporate VAT numbers in real time via the official European Commission VIES REST API, returning legal entity names, registered addresses, and member-state availability status.

tools.name: search_eu_ted_tenders
tools.description: Search European public procurement tenders and contract notices from the official EU Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) Open API v3 by keywords, 8-digit CPV codes, and 3-letter ISO country codes.

servers.name: NPPES NPI Registry Scraper — Clinic Owners ($0.50/1k)
servers.description: Query official CMS NPPES NPI Registry v2.1 organization records to extract dental, medspa, dermatology, physical therapy, optometry, and clinic Authorized Officials (owners/presidents), credentials, direct phone numbers, and corporate-chain filtering.
servers.dataSources: CMS NPPES NPI Registry API v2.1

tools.name: search_healthcare_practice_owners
tools.description: Search US dental, medspa, dermatology, physical therapy, chiropractic, optometry, urgent care, pharmacy, and specialty healthcare practice organizations (CMS NPPES v2.1 NPI-2) to extract Authorized Official (owner/president) names, clinician credentials (DDS, DMD, MD, DO, PT), direct phone numbers, ownership classification, and 0-100 B2B lead scores.

tools.name: lookup_practice_by_npi
tools.description: Look up a specific US healthcare practice organization by its 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) from CMS NPPES v2.1 and return normalized Authorized Official, phones, taxonomy, ownership type, and lead score.

servers.name: DMARC, SPF, MX & Domain Security Scraper ($0.50/1k)
servers.description: Zero-key RFC infrastructure intelligence: inspect DNS MX email providers (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint), SPF SaaS senders, DMARC spoofing gaps, live TLS X.509 certificates, IANA RDAP domain age, and RIPEstat BGP ASNs.
servers.dataSources: Native RFC DNS (MX/SPF/DMARC/NS), TLS SNI, IANA RDAP, RIPEstat BGP

tools.name: audit_domain_posture
tools.description: Audit a single B2B domain (accepts raw domain, URL, or email address) via pure RFC protocols: DNS MX Email Provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast, etc.), SPF policy & third-party SaaS senders (HubSpot, Salesforce, SendGrid, etc.), DMARC spoofing vulnerability, TLS X.509 certificate & SAN subdomains, IANA RDAP domain age & registrar, RIPEstat BGP/ASN hosting, and 0-100 security posture score.

tools.name: batch_audit_domains
tools.description: Batch-audit up to 50 B2B domains concurrently via pure RFC protocols (DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/NS, TLS X.509 certificates, official IANA RDAP domain age & registrar, and RIPEstat BGP/ASN hosting) for GTM enrichment, MSP security prospecting, and vendor KYB triage.

servers.name: Code Violations & Distressed Property Scraper ($0.80/1k)
servers.description: Multi-city municipal code enforcement and distressed property lead feed harmonizing 6 US Socrata open-data portals with parcel IDs, geocodes, structural/vacancy/blight classification, and investor distress scoring.
servers.dataSources: Austin, SF, Seattle, Buffalo, Montgomery MD & Cincinnati Socrata APIs

tools.name: search_code_violation_leads
tools.description: Search active municipal code enforcement, housing habitability violations, condemned/vacant structures, blight, and distressed property leads across 6 US Socrata portals (Austin, Seattle, San Francisco, Buffalo, Montgomery County MD, Cincinnati) with parcel IDs, geocodes, distress scores, and investor priority tiers.

tools.name: list_code_violation_metros
tools.description: List all 6 supported US municipal code enforcement Socrata portals (Austin, Seattle, San Francisco, Buffalo, Montgomery County MD, Cincinnati), their live dataset URLs, ordering fields, and supported distress filters.

servers.name: EPA ECHO Scraper — Violations & Penalties ($0.50/1k)
servers.description: Screen US industrial plants, refineries, and utilities via US EPA ECHO APIs for Clean Water Act (NPDES), Clean Air Act, and RCRA Hazardous Waste Significant Non-Compliance (SNC/HPV) flags, inspections, and civil penalties.
servers.dataSources: US EPA ECHO REST APIs (Clean Water NPDES, Clean Air, RCRA)

tools.name: search_epa_facility_violations
tools.description: Screen US industrial facilities, manufacturing plants, refineries, and utilities for Clean Water Act (NPDES), Clean Air Act, and RCRA hazardous waste violations, SNC/HPV flags, inspections, and civil penalties via official US EPA ECHO REST APIs.

tools.name: lookup_facility_compliance
tools.description: Look up cross-statute US EPA compliance history, permits, inspections, SNC status, and penalties for a specific facility by EPA FRS Registry ID, source permit ID (NPDES/AIR/RCRA), or facility name.

servers.name: Clinical Trials & PubMed Scraper — PI Emails ($0.50/1k)
servers.description: Combine NIH ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 and EMBL-EBI Europe PMC / PubMed to extract recruiting clinical trial Principal Investigators, direct unmasked contact emails & phones, pharma/academic sponsors, citations, and NIH grant IDs.
servers.dataSources: NIH ClinicalTrials.gov REST API v2, EMBL-EBI Europe PMC / PubMed

tools.name: find_clinical_trial_investigators
tools.description: Find active Recruiting and upcoming clinical trial Principal Investigators, direct Central Contacts (unmasked emails and phone numbers), biotech/pharma vs academic sponsors, trial phases, and clinical sites via official NIH ClinicalTrials.gov REST API v2.

tools.name: search_pubmed_kol_experts
tools.description: Search peer-reviewed biomedical Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and Principal Investigators from official PubMed / EMBL-EBI Europe PMC APIs, extracting institutional affiliations, corresponding emails, citation counts, NIH/research grant IDs, ORCIDs, and open-access links.

servers.name: SEC Form 4 Insider Trading & Cluster Buy Signals Scraper
servers.description: Real-time US corporate insider purchases, sales, Rule 10b5-1 flags, and multi-insider cluster buy signals from official SEC EDGAR Form 4 XML filings and Submissions/EFTS APIs.
servers.dataSources: SEC EDGAR Form 4 XML, SEC Submissions API, SEC EFTS API

tools.name: search_form4_insider_trades
tools.description: Search real-time US corporate insider buys and sales from official SEC EDGAR Form 4 XML filings. Filter by stock tickers, CIKs, date window, open-market purchases only (code P), Rule 10b5-1 plan exclusion, or minimum USD transaction value. Returns insider role, 10b5-1 flag, transaction rows, clusterBuyCount, and 0-100 signalScore.

tools.name: get_company_insider_dossier
tools.description: Pull a complete insider trading dossier for a specific US public company by stock ticker (e.g., "NVDA") or 10-digit SEC CIK, summarizing net insider buying vs selling, Rule 10b5-1 plan ratio, cluster buy count, and recent Form 4 / 4/A filings.

tools.name: detect_insider_cluster_buys
tools.description: Scan recent SEC Form 4 filings for multi-insider open-market cluster buys (2+ distinct insiders purchasing shares of the same company with code P), prioritizing discretionary C-suite buys outside Rule 10b5-1 plans.

servers.name: FDA 510(k) & PMA Medical Device Clearances Scraper
servers.description: Track newly cleared US FDA 510(k) and Premarket Approval (PMA) medical devices via official openFDA Device APIs with direct applicant contacts, product codes, device classes, and recall history.
servers.dataSources: US FDA openFDA Device APIs (510k, PMA, Enforcement Recalls)

tools.name: search_fda_device_clearances
tools.description: Search newly cleared FDA 510(k) and Premarket Approval (PMA) medical devices via official openFDA APIs, returning normalized device names, direct applicant contact names, mailing addresses, product codes, device classes, FDA summary URLs, and optional openFDA device recall history.

tools.name: get_medtech_applicant_dossier
tools.description: Build a 360-degree FDA regulatory dossier for a specific MedTech manufacturer/applicant, combining recent 510(k) clearances (with direct regulatory contacts), PMA approvals/supplements, and full openFDA device recall/enforcement history.

tools.name: lookup_fda_clearance_by_id
tools.description: Look up a specific FDA 510(k) K-number (e.g., "K261026") or PMA ID (e.g., "P900056") with direct applicant contact info and optional openFDA device recall history.

servers.name: IRS Form 990 Nonprofit & Foundation Grantmakers Scraper
servers.description: Extract verified IRS Form 990, 990-PF & 990-EZ financials, executive compensation, endowment assets, grants paid, and official filing PDFs for US 501(c) nonprofits and grantmaking foundations via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API v2.
servers.dataSources: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API v2, IRS EO BMF, IRS Form 990 / 990-PF / 990-EZ

tools.name: search_nonprofit_990_leads
tools.description: Search US 501(c) nonprofits, hospitals, universities, and private grantmaking foundations via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API v2, enriched with latest IRS Form 990 / 990-PF / 990-EZ financials, executive compensation, grants paid, PDF filing URLs, and lead quality scores.

tools.name: get_nonprofit_990_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve a complete IRS Form 990/990-PF/990-EZ financial dossier for a specific US nonprofit or foundation by 9-digit EIN (e.g., "13-1684331") or organization name (e.g., "Ford Foundation"), including up to 5 recent multi-year filings.

tools.name: screen_high_asset_foundations
tools.description: Screen active US grantmaking foundations above a minimum asset threshold (default $1,000,000), returning ranked Form 990-PF and Community Foundation prospects with combined assets, total grants paid, and state breakdown.

servers.name: CISA KEV, EPSS & NVD Exploited CVE Vulnerability Scanner
servers.description: Fuse live CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), FIRST.org EPSS exploit probabilities, and optional NIST NVD v2 CVSS scores into deterministic 0-100 patch priority rankings with ransomware linkage and BOD due dates.
servers.dataSources: CISA KEV Catalog, FIRST.org EPSS API v1, NIST NVD CVE API v2

tools.name: search_exploited_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Search and prioritize active CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) filtered by vendor, product, keyword, ransomware linkage, KEV dateAdded window, or minimum FIRST.org EPSS probability. Returns 0-100 patchPriorityScore rankings, federal BOD due dates, EPSS scores, and optional NIST NVD v2 CVSS.

tools.name: score_cve_exploit_risk
tools.description: Score 1 to 10 specific CVE identifiers (e.g., "CVE-2024-3400" or ["CVE-2021-44228", "CVE-2026-132224"]) by fusing CISA KEV active-exploitation status, FIRST.org EPSS probability/percentile, and NIST NVD v2 CVSS baseScore into a deterministic 0-100 patch priority dossier.

tools.name: summarize_vendor_kev_exposure
tools.description: Summarize a software or hardware vendor/project exposure across the live CISA KEV catalog, reporting total KEV entries, ransomware-linked count, overdue BOD directives, top affected products, top CWEs, and EPSS-ranked top vulnerabilities.

servers.name: SEC Form 13F Hedge Fund & Whale Holdings Scraper
servers.description: Extract real-time US institutional investor, family office, and hedge fund equity & Put/Call option holdings from official SEC EDGAR Form 13F-HR XML filings with exact USD values, CUSIP/FIGI identifiers, portfolio weights, and compliance signer contacts.
servers.dataSources: SEC EDGAR Form 13F-HR XML (primary_doc.xml + informationTable), SEC Submissions API, SEC EFTS API

tools.name: search_13f_whale_holdings
tools.description: Search real-time US institutional investor & hedge fund holdings from official SEC EDGAR Form 13F-HR XML filings (primary_doc.xml + informationTable). Filter by manager CIKs, issuer/ticker/CUSIP/fund keyword, Put/Call options only, minimum USD position value, and top N holdings per manager.

tools.name: get_fund_13f_portfolio
tools.description: Pull the latest SEC Form 13F-HR portfolio summary and largest holdings for a specific institutional manager or hedge fund by CIK (e.g., "0001067983") or manager name (e.g., "Berkshire Hathaway"). Returns total reported AUM, tableEntryTotal, signer contact, and top positions with portfolio weights.

tools.name: find_institutional_holders_by_issuer
tools.description: Find institutional whale managers holding a specific stock issuer, ticker, or 9-character CUSIP across recent SEC Form 13F-HR filings (e.g., "NVIDIA", "NVDA", or "67066G104"), ranked by USD position value descending.

servers.name: OFAC Sanctions, AML & Crypto Wallet Screening API
servers.description: Screen individuals, companies, vessels, aircraft, aliases, and crypto wallet addresses against live US Treasury OFAC SDN, ALT, ADD, and Consolidated Non-SDN lists with deterministic 0-100 match scoring and <15 ms cached Standby MCP lookup.
servers.dataSources: US Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Service (SDN.CSV, ALT.CSV, ADD.CSV, CONS_PRIM.CSV)

tools.name: screen_entities_ofac_aml
tools.description: Screen 1 to 100 individual, company, vessel, or aircraft names against the live US Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN lists plus ALT.CSV aliases. Returns deterministic 0-100 matchScore, matchDecision, programs, addresses, crypto wallets, and parsed IDs.

tools.name: screen_crypto_wallet_sanctions
tools.description: Screen 1 to 100 cryptocurrency wallet addresses (BTC/XBT, ETH, USDT, USDC, TRX, XMR, LTC, SOL) against OFAC-sanctioned digital currency addresses parsed from SDN Remarks, or list sanctioned OFAC wallet holders filtered by blockchain currency or OFAC program.

tools.name: search_ofac_sanctions_by_program
tools.description: Browse and filter live US Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN entries by sanctions program (SDGT, CYBER2, RUSSIA-EO14024, DPRK, IRAN, CMIC, CUBA), country, entity type (individual, entity, vessel, aircraft), or keyword.

servers.name: US Federal Register Rules, Notices & Executive Orders Scraper
servers.description: Track newly published US Federal Register Final Rules, Proposed Rules (with open public comment deadlines), Notices, and Presidential Executive Orders via federalregister.gov API v1 with CFR citations, dockets, RINs, effective/comment countdowns, and 0-100 regulatory impact scores.
servers.dataSources: US Federal Register REST API v1 (federalregister.gov/api/v1)

tools.name: search_federal_register_rules
tools.description: Search newly published US Federal Register Final Rules, Proposed Rules, Notices, and Presidential Executive Orders via official federalregister.gov API v1. Returns normalized CFR citations, agencies, dockets, RINs, effective/comment countdowns, urgency tier, and 0-100 regulatory impact scores.

tools.name: track_open_comment_deadlines
tools.description: Track US Federal Register Proposed Rules and Notices with active, open public comment windows (comments_close_on >= today), sorted by soonest closing deadline and regulatory impact score so legal and government-affairs teams never miss a comment cutoff.

tools.name: get_federal_register_document
tools.description: Look up a specific US Federal Register document by official document number (e.g., "2026-24141") with full normalized CFR citations, agencies, dockets, RINs, comment counts, effective/comment countdowns, and regulatory impact score.

servers.name: FDIC Bank Financial Health, Call Reports & Risk Scraper
servers.description: Screen US FDIC-insured banks via official FDIC BankFind Suite REST API (institutions, quarterly Call Report financials, bank failures) enriched with CFPB consumer complaints. Extracts Tier 1 leverage (RBC1AAJ), ROA/ROE, non-current loans, and 0-100 bankHealthScore.
servers.dataSources: FDIC BankFind Suite REST API (Institutions, Financials, Failures), CFPB Consumer Complaints

tools.name: screen_us_bank_health
tools.description: Screen US FDIC-insured banks via official FDIC BankFind Suite REST API (institutions, latest Call Report financials, failure registry) and CFPB Consumer Complaint Database. Returns normalized assets/deposits/equity in $k and USD, Tier 1 leverage (RBC1AAJ), ROA/ROE, non-current loan ratio, CFPB complaint count, deterministic 0-100 bankHealthScore, and riskTier.

tools.name: search_fdic_bank_failures
tools.description: Search the official FDIC Bank Failures & Assistance Transactions registry (/api/failures) by bank name, FDIC CERT number, state, or failure year range. Returns failure dates, resolution type (RESTYPE), insurance fund (DIF/BIF/SAIF), assets/deposits at failure, and estimated DIF loss cost.

tools.name: compare_bank_financial_ratios
tools.description: Compare 2 or more US FDIC-insured banks side-by-side across Call Report capital adequacy (Tier 1 leverage RBC1AAJ, equity/assets), profitability (ROA, ROE), asset quality (non-current loan ratio), CFPB complaint counts, and 0-100 bankHealthScore for sponsor-bank or treasury counterparty selection.

servers.name: US Product, Vehicle, Food & Drug Recalls Scraper (CPSC, FDA)
servers.description: Unified US Federal Recall Monitor across CPSC SaferProducts consumer goods, NHTSA vehicle/equipment recalls (DO_NOT_DRIVE & PARK_OUTSIDE flags), and openFDA Class I/II/III food & drug enforcement recalls with UPCs, retailers, hazards, remedies, and 0-100 recallSeverityScore.
servers.dataSources: US CPSC SaferProducts API, US NHTSA Recalls API, US openFDA Food & Drug Enforcement API

tools.name: search_cpsc_product_recalls
tools.description: Search official US CPSC SaferProducts consumer product recalls by keyword, retailer (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco), lookback window (daysBack), and minimum severity score. Returns normalized UPCs, models, retailers, hazards, injuries, remedies, and 0-100 recallSeverityScore.

tools.name: check_nhtsa_vehicle_recalls
tools.description: Check official US NHTSA Vehicle & Equipment Recalls by make/model/modelYear or NHTSA campaignNumber. Returns parkOutSide / DO_NOT_DRIVE flags, affected components, crash/fire consequences, dealer remedies, and 0-100 recallSeverityScore.

tools.name: search_fda_enforcement_recalls
tools.description: Search official openFDA Food & Drug Enforcement recalls (Class I / II / III) by productType ("food", "drug", or "both"), keyword query, retailer/distribution channel, FDA classification, and daysBack. Handles 0-match queries cleanly and returns normalized UPCs/NDCs, recalling firms, and 0-100 severity scores.

servers.name: SEC Form 8-K Material Events, M&A, Cyber & CEO Scraper
servers.description: Monitor real-time SEC EDGAR Form 8-K & 8-K/A material corporate events: Item 1.05 cybersecurity incidents, Item 1.01/2.01 M&A deals, Item 5.02 CEO/CFO departures, Item 2.05/2.06 layoffs, Item 1.03/3.01 bankruptcy/delisting, and Item 4.02 restatements with 0-100 materialityScore.
servers.dataSources: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search (EFTS efts.sec.gov), SEC Submissions API (data.sec.gov)

tools.name: search_sec_8k_material_events
tools.description: Search US public company SEC Form 8-K & 8-K/A material event filings via official SEC EDGAR EFTS API. Filter by eventCategory (cybersecurity, ma_deals, exec_changes, layoffs_distress, accounting), explicit 8-K itemCodes (e.g. ["1.05","5.02"]), keyword query, or stock tickers/CIKs. Returns decoded item labels, materialityScore (0-100), severityTier, B2B outreachAngle, and direct EDGAR filing URLs.

tools.name: scan_cyber_and_distress_8k_alerts
tools.description: Scan high-severity SEC Form 8-K & 8-K/A trigger alerts across Item 1.05 (material cybersecurity incidents), Item 1.03 (bankruptcy), Item 2.04/2.05/2.06 (debt acceleration, layoffs, impairments), Item 3.01 (exchange delisting), Item 4.01/4.02 (auditor changes & restatements), and Item 5.02 (CEO/CFO turnover), ranked by highest materialityScore.

tools.name: get_company_8k_event_timeline
tools.description: Retrieve a complete Form 8-K / 8-K/A material event timeline for a specific US public company by stock ticker (e.g., "AAPL", "CRWD") or 10-digit SEC CIK via official data.sec.gov/submissions, including SIC classification, exchanges, decoded item codes, materiality scores, and direct filing URLs.
